_doc: Plumage axis (SPEC_PET_DESIGN_AXES §2) — surface: feathers. A whole different vocabulary per surface reads truer than one 'coat' axis with the fur options greyed out on a bird (§0.3). min_strength 0.9 is MEASURED (Phase 3, 2026-07-16, txt2img blue jay at fixed seed): at 0.85 all four options were prior-locked (identical to the base); at 0.9 each visibly changes the still, though the options read SIMILAR to one another (richer/sharper feathering more than four distinct textures) — the vocabulary wants sharper wording from the look owner; see the spec's §11.2.
